race.comment: AGADOO (4) has been very competitive in metro grade of late and should find this assignment much more to her liking. Again gets the services of gun hoop Wiggins in the irons and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Sure to be right there when the whips are cracking. The well-related EDGE OF INFINITY (6) (half to G2 winner and 2xG1 placed Osipenko) has hit the top-five at her past seven outings and looks to be knocking on the door of a maiden victory. Include in calculations. SILENT ANSWER (11) is a former SA based galloper having her first run for the new stable but should find this easier than what she faced down south. Respect any push in betting. KARMA COMET (15) is facing the starter for the first time and a watch on betting is advised. MAHMOA (2) next best with the claim.
